gui.pattern_converter.override.title: Direction override
jei.pattern_converter.info.1: Place encoded patterns from either storage mod in the input grid together with blank patterns of the other mod, and the Pattern Converter re-encodes them through that mod's own pattern API. The emptied originals come back as blanks.
jei.pattern_converter.info.2: Direction is detected per pattern; the ⇕ button locks it. A redstone pulse fires after every cycle that converted something, and a comparator reads the output grid.
jei.pattern_converter.info.3: Patterns that cannot be represented on the other side (e.g. energy resources without a matching addon, or more outputs than AE2 allows) are refused with the reason shown in the GUI.
